Structured Concurrency: Java 21 StructuredTaskScope handles forks.

• Splitter / Aggregator: Splits cart into line items; reassembles totals.
• Dead-Mans Timer: Drops lagging suppliers after 300ms SLA barrier.
• Resilience: Partial fulfillment fallback if non-critical suppliers fail.
• Realization: Virtual threads, Kafka RecipientList / Aggregator.

• Atomicity without 2PC: Replaces heavy distributed XA locks.
• Orchestrator vs Choreography: Centralized state engine prevents loops.
• Idempotent Compensations: Compensation actions MUST be idempotent.
• Realization: Temporal, AWS Step Functions, Custom State Machine.

At-Least-Once Reality: Network retries and redrives cause duplicates.
Atomic Deduplication: Unique message key inserted with state in 1 TX.
Fencing Tokens: Monotonic sequence numbers block stale executions.

• Compare-And-Swap: Guards against racing concurrent consumers.
• Expiring Key Cache: Sliding Redis Bloom filter suppresses redundant checks.
• State Determinism: Duplicate message returns cached result cleanly.
• Realization: PostgreSQL UNIQUE index, Redis SETNX, DynamoDB COND.

div.span: Atomic Ingress • Non-Blocking Conduits • Idempotent Processing

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding-top: 741px; margin-left: 29px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #1E293B;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'Comic Sans MS'; color: light-dark(#1E293B, #c3ccdc); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: nowrap;

div.div:
Core Architectural Principles of EIP Macro Composition:
• The Dual-Write Barrier: Ingress must use Transactional Outbox + CDC to eliminate distributed inconsistency between databases and brokers.
• Bounded Concurrency & Backpressure: Every consumer and pipeline must define strict queue depth bounds; unconstrained buffers inevitably trigger cascading OOM failures.
• Universal Idempotence: In at-least-once distributed fabrics, network retries, broker rebalances, and saga rollbacks guarantee duplicate deliveries.
• Distributed Observability: W3C traceparent headers must traverse every broker boundary to maintain end-to-end causal DAG visibility.
